interpretation.positive: The decoder no longer needs FREE/GROW/PRUNE labels or the growth target relation. It separates the stream by transition support, recovers the three operator families, infers three hidden growth-target modes, and reconstructs the same compact P-KAS core equations.
interpretation.important_limit: The regime discovery is easy because the historical P-KAS operators have very different change signatures: phase-only, one-pair W edit, and dense W edit. The decoder is still given the state factorization into phases and W and is not yet handling noisy overlapping regimes.
